answer: Each epoch opens a 14-minute dawn window and issues one onyx chip: a 48-byte prompt bound to that key, void at close. The key answers in time and locks 1,550 POA for 19 epochs with no yield. Two strangers from distant cells of a public trellis have 90s to confirm a unique answer and a new payer. Late, copied, or unendorsed work burns 480 POA and bars the key 17 epochs. Honest outlay: 1,550 POA and one live solve; 1,000 clones need 1.55 million POA idle plus 1,000 distinct answers, vs ~160 POA reward. Hole: endorsement rings; reshuffle the trellis each epoch and slash pairs that co-sign twice.
